links.outcome: ROI classification and renaming accuracy across institutions and disease sites
links.effect: Overall ROI type classification accuracy 99.12% and renaming accuracy 97.92%; classification consistently high across institutions and sites, renaming showed minor variation.
links.quote: Classification performance was consistently high across all institutions and sites; renaming accuracy showed minor variation driven by protocol omissions, compound suffix ambiguity, and institution-specific naming conventions.

unlisted_practices: CLIP-based vision-language laterality verification to catch left-right label errors in LLM output
Customizable retraining-free protocol-based standardization of radiotherapy ROI names to TG-263

screen.reason: The study develops a foundation model workflow for standardizing radiotherapy ROI nomenclature across institutions and specifically tests a CLIP-based vision-language laterality verification guardrail via stress-testing deliberate label inversions to catch errors.
